craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta of inner ocean; vyabhicāri vismaya at rise-set-at-once. Sanskrit-first: antaḥ-samudra (INNER-OCEAN — kept); yugapad (AT-ONCE — kept; simultaneity IS the wonder). Rows: 9 (moon/sun/fire + creation/keeping/loosing — lights AND acts rise-set together), 1 (‘one gleam’ closes — multiplicity gathered last), 10 (ocean left standing). Close: ‘one gleam’. Rupture: colon (ocean stated, then its simultaneity). Rejected: SD variant — killed: print followed (recorded); ‘together’ for at-once — killed: yugapat kept (technical simultaneity). Read aloud: DEEP with-IN-you a-LONE, GLO-ry-THROB-bing, O-cean-KNOW-ing, WAVES-tast-ing-FREE … THEY-rise AND-set AT-once: MOON, SUN, FIRE, cre-A-tion, KEEP-ing, LOOS-ing, ONE-gleam.

lines: Deep within You alone, glory throbbing, ocean knowing, waves tasting free,
they rise and set at once: moon, sun, fire, creation, keeping, loosing, one gleam.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tavaivaikasyāntaḥ sphuritamahaso | sṛṣṭisthitilayamaya sphūrjitarucāṃ śaśāṅkārkāgnīnāṃ yugapad udayāpāyavibhavāḥ

reads_against.argmap: What rises-sets at once within You alone? → Ocean within; moon-sun-fire rise-set at once.
c1_essence: Inner ocean; triple lights rise-set at once.
